data.name: Jivanlal
data.gender_notes: Jivanlal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jivan: Living, Lal: Spirit. This name signifies a person who embodies the living spirit, radiating vitality and consciousness. The name Jivanlal carries the meaning “Living Spirit” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jivanlal usually hope their child will grow to embody living spirit and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the essence of life.
data.etymology: Jivanlal belongs to the Hindi linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Living Spirit.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jivanlal total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
